title: Robot Horse and Pilot Steal the Show at Chinese Robotics Conference
seoTitle: Robot Horse Highlights China Robotics Event
subtitle: Among over 300 exhibits, the mechanical duo captivates in Beijing
excerpt: In a five‑day gathering in Beijing, more than 300 companies showcase robotic innovations, spotlighting a robot horse and its pilot.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
A robot horse accompanied by its mechanical pilot became the focal point of a major robotics event that brings together over 300 companies. The highlight occurred during the five‑day exhibition in Beijing, China, where organizers reported multiple demonstrations of advanced technology.

A Mechanical Spectacle Among Hundreds of Exhibitors

The event, which runs for almost a week, aims to showcase the latest advances in robotics. Among the various areas covered, the robot horse and its driver received special attention, symbolizing the ability to combine mobility and precise control on autonomous platforms.

Fair Context

With the participation of more than 300 companies, the conference offers a broad overview of trends in automation, artificial intelligence, and mechanical systems. The presence of a robot horse demonstrates the practical application of technologies that were traditionally confined to industrial settings, expanding their use to public demonstrations and entertainment.

  • Over 300 companies showcasing innovations.
  • Event lasting five days.
  • Location: Beijing, China.
  • Highlight: a robot horse accompanied by a pilot.

The focus on the robot horse underscores the growing interest in robots that can interact in complex environments, offering possibilities ranging from research to commercial applications. As the conference continues, attention remains on demonstrations that combine advanced engineering and creativity.

With information from BBC News.
